content: Keep love in your heart. A life without it is like a sunless garden when the flowers are dead.
author: Oscar Wilde
story:
Celebrated as the toast of London's theatrical world before being sentenced to two years of hard labor in Reading Gaol for his sexuality, Oscar Wilde experienced the catastrophic extremes of adulation and ruin. In prison, stripped of vanity and wit, he penned De Profundis, discovering that suffering when deeply integrated creates an artist's truest spiritual depth.

Exploring the mysteries of human connection, Oscar Wilde saw that genuine fulfillment cannot be hoarded or manufactured through egoic control. It blossoms only when we lower our defenses, dissolve self-importance, and meet the world with openhearted generosity.
reflectionPrompt: What defensive wall or grudge are you holding onto that is keeping genuine warmth and intimacy away?
